title: Typical design criteria for sizing mesophilic anaerobic sludge digesters
markdown:
| Parameters | Low Rate Digestion | High Rate Digestion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Volatile Solids Loading Rate, kgVSS/day/m³ | 0.6 - 1.6 | 1.6 - 6.4 |
| Solids Retention Time, days | (*) | 10 - 20 |
| Hydraulic Retention Time, days | 30 - 40 | 10 - 20 |
notes: Printed note below the table, kept with the table region: 'Note:  (*) Computation of actual SRT is difficult as it depends on the capacity utilization.'

The table prints 'kgVSS/day/m³' with no space between kg and VSS and with a superscript 3, while the running text immediately above prints 'kg VSS/day/m3' with a space and a plain 3. Both forms kept as printed.
The Low Rate Digestion cell for Solids Retention Time prints only the asterisk reference '(*)', not a number; it is not filled in from the note or from Table 6.9.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 288-450 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed table is set sideways; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed and no verification seal.
